corrections.reason: Connected surface approach did not match the requested separated front/back/side panels; leg-driven stretching rejected.
Whole rigid panel rotations looked like boards; retain separation but add modest downward bending with edge-length limits.

User reported excessive side flapping during run and raised side pelts in combat idle. Side-only heavier damping/gravity, reduced wearer-motion response, 0.65rad hinge cap, closer colliders and local thigh contact replace whole-panel lifting. An angle-cap-only trial hid cloth inside the thighs and was discarded.

User requested motion between the previous light/heavy settings and one fold at the side midpoint. Side damping/gravity/inertia interpolated; a separately damped second hinge bends the lower half with delayed motion. Original GLB topology, texture and hip-only skinning retained.

User-marked longitudinal centerline now folds the front/rear wings of each side pelt inward. This adds a second bend direction to the retained midpoint hinge; medium motion tuning retained. Waist anchor and original edge-length limits verified.

User requested side pelt clearance in combat idle, more lift during walking and a straight upper back pelt. Side minimum hinge 0.24rad plus forward/backward thigh response 0.45, 1.05rad cap, wider hip/thigh contacts and 0.16rad crease retained with midpoint bending. Contact edge projection now uses 512 passes with the same 2% + 1um cap to prevent the final length correction from undoing thigh clearance. Back droop reduced to 0.15 with local contact instead of whole-panel thigh lifting.

User reported large FPS loss versus barbarian and requested rebuilding in that style. Retire dense 128/512-iteration bending, retain source belt/decorations and rigid front/back hinges, resample sides into 9x11 cloth grids and reuse barbarian fur material with four constraint iterations.
